an4.85:1.1: “There are these four types of people to be found existing in the world.
an4.85:1.3: One in darkness who is headed for darkness,
an4.85:1.4: one in darkness who is headed for light,
an4.85:1.5: one in light who is headed for darkness,
an4.85:1.6: and one in light who is headed for light.
an4.85:2.1: “And how is one the type of person in darkness who is headed for darkness?
an4.85:2.2: There is the case where a person is born into a lower class family—the family of a scavenger, a hunter, a basket-weaver, a wheelwright, or a sweeper—a family that is poor, with little food or drink, living in hardship, where food & clothing are hard to come by.
an4.85:2.3: And he is ugly, misshapen, stunted, & sickly: half-blind or deformed or lame or crippled. He doesn’t receive any (gifts of) food, drink, clothing, or vehicles; garlands, perfumes, or ointments; bedding, shelter, or lamps.
an4.85:2.4: He engages in bodily misconduct, verbal misconduct, & mental misconduct.
an4.85:2.5: Having engaged in bodily misconduct, verbal misconduct, & mental misconduct, he—on the break-up of the body, after death—reappears in a plane of deprivation, a bad destination, a lower realm, hell.
an4.85:2.6: This is the type of person in darkness who is headed for darkness.
an4.85:3.1: “And how is one the type of person in darkness who is headed for light?
an4.85:3.2: There is the case where a person is born into a lower class family—the family of a scavenger, a hunter, a basket-weaver, a wheelwright, or a sweeper—a family that is poor, with little food or drink, living in hardship, where food & clothing are hard to come by.
an4.85:3.3: And he is ugly, misshapen, stunted, & sickly: half-blind or deformed or lame or crippled. He doesn’t receive any (gifts of) food, drink, clothing, or vehicles; garlands, perfumes, or ointments; bedding, shelter, or lamps.
an4.85:3.4: He engages in good bodily conduct, good verbal conduct, & good mental conduct.
an4.85:3.5: Having engaged in good bodily conduct, good verbal conduct, & good mental conduct, he—on the break-up of the body, after death—reappears in a good destination, a heavenly world.
an4.85:3.6: This is the type of person in darkness who is headed for light.
an4.85:4.1: “And how is one the type of person in light who is headed for darkness?
an4.85:4.2: There is the case where a person is born into an upper class family—a noble warrior family, a brahman family, a prosperous householder family—a family that is rich, with much wealth, with many possessions, with a great deal of money, a great many accoutrements of wealth, a great many commodities.
an4.85:4.3: And he is well-built, handsome, extremely inspiring, endowed with a lotus-like complexion. He receives (gifts of) food, drink, clothing, & vehicles; garlands, perfumes, & ointments; bedding, shelter, & lamps.
an4.85:4.4: He engages in bodily misconduct, verbal misconduct, & mental misconduct.
an4.85:4.5: Having engaged in bodily misconduct, verbal misconduct, & mental misconduct, he—on the break-up of the body, after death—reappears in a plane of deprivation, a bad destination, a lower realm, hell.
an4.85:4.6: This is the type of person in light who is headed for darkness.
an4.85:5.1: “And how is one the type of person in light who is headed for light?
an4.85:5.2: There is the case where a person is born into an upper class family—a noble warrior family, a brahman family, a prosperous householder family—a family that is rich, with much wealth, with many possessions, with a great deal of money, a great many accoutrements of wealth, a great many commodities.
an4.85:5.3: And he is well-built, handsome, extremely inspiring, endowed with a lotus-like complexion. He receives (gifts of) food, drink, clothing, & vehicles; garlands, perfumes, & ointments; bedding, shelter, & lamps.
an4.85:5.4: He engages in good bodily conduct, good verbal conduct, & good mental conduct.
an4.85:5.5: Having engaged in good bodily conduct, good verbal conduct, & good mental conduct, he—on the break-up of the body, after death—reappears in a good destination, a heavenly world.
an4.85:5.6: This is the type of person in light who is headed for light.
an4.85:5.7: “These are the four types of people to be found existing in the world.”
